# A110 hpc_work_planning

This existing `hpc` episode is commissioned by `legacy_annotation`. The binding inventory retains its original files, symbols, dependencies and current private source hashes. Its full responsibility split is incomplete: central task execution still uses the axis runtime, and the existing requests/returns and binding implementation require further review.

## 2026-11-11 monitor message ownership

`to_child_execution_progress_assessment.py -> execution_progress_assessment/from_parent.py` prepares the selected target, requested fields, known observations and permitted records. `execution_progress_assessment/to_parent.py -> from_child_execution_progress_assessment.py` validates requested progress references and records them with the original provider signature and delivery key. Runtime chooses the original child from saved actions/report attempts, including repair; mismatched parents are rejected. The parent does not poll or manufacture progress in these message functions.

All 30 existing parent methods retain their bodies. The two explicit connectors are additions. Current fingerprints include both new message files; configuration and historical descriptor provenance remain distinct. Four local boundary checks pass, using the shared database-only test helper under root/tests. The full run had 504 passes and 28 failures; 26 failures came from the test expecting ContractError instead of the original ReportBoundaryError. Correcting that assertion and rerunning those 26 checks gives 530 current passes; two A106 scientific Store construction checks retain their reproduced pre-existing failure. Evidence: `runs/monitor_parent_tree_20261111_{baseline02,connect,behavior,recheck,records}/`. These checks do not establish scientific execution, autonomous HPC behavior or whole-workflow restoration.

## 2026-11-11 prediction message ownership

`to_child_hpc_resource_prediction.py -> hpc_resource_prediction/from_parent.py`
prepares the selected original commission and owner. The child retains independent
admission validation. `hpc_resource_prediction/to_parent.py ->
from_child_hpc_resource_prediction.py` receives the admitted typed report using
the original recorded-admission cache, declared source references, progress
provider, timing/attribution receipts and operation keys. Model progress remains
in the original shared parent ledger; receiving the report does not credit it twice.

`episode.py:child_report_receiver` selects only this parent's prediction handler.
Runtime resolves the original saved child action/report attempt before selecting
it, including redelivery. Other child roles retain the original receipt body.
The existing parent configuration, child implementation, mathematical definitions,
credit, yield and continuation are unchanged. Both new message files enter the
parent's implementation fingerprint. Earlier descriptors remain dated provenance.

Across ten parents, 120 prediction exchange checks and 40 existing monitor
exchange checks pass. Actual local ledgers, typed contracts and journals are used;
provider/receipt ports, cache results and child construction are controlled.
Source comparison and current descriptors are retained under
`runs/hpc_prediction_messages_20261111_audit02/` and
`runs/hpc_prediction_messages_20261111_records/`; baseline and final behavior
receipts are in the corresponding `baseline_tests` and `combined` directories.

This parent still requires its full goal/task/mixed-role responsibility split.
Prediction prompt and calculator ownership, full saved reopening, autonomous
science and shared-root integration remain unfinished. A104's inherited missing
closed-HPC reference branch is recorded separately; child custody checks do not
establish that runtime restoration path.

## 2026-11-11 mathematical library and continuation-estimator ownership

This private binding selects its axis's `library/hpc_prediction.py`,
`library/hpc_resource_prediction.py` and `library/hpc_continuation.py` using the
original commission and its own ledger verifier. Time/resource inference,
calibration, portfolio expectations, measured units and continuation behavior
are unchanged. The source fingerprint names all three actual library homes;
binding identity and configuration are retained. There is one implementation of
each calculation within each axis, with separate copies across axes.

The continuation estimator was removed from `hpc_monitoring.py`; its existing
monitor scheduler, exception and policy validation remain unchanged. Prediction
has no monitoring/wait actions. Commission-policy validation explains its remaining
indirect dependency on that module. Pending value remains an estimate, not earned
credit, and unresolved acceptance remains an upper bound.

The baseline has 155 passes across thirty private consumers and five libraries.
The expanded run has 784 passes and eleven file-descriptor exhaustion failures;
all eleven failed checks pass in a fresh-process retry, yielding 795 distinct
passing checks across both receipts. The unchanged read-only SQLite connection
in `HPCLedger.open_existing` lacks explicit closure in all five axes; this
inherited lifecycle defect remains open. Existing prediction tasks, prompts,
messages and monitor exchanges are included. Actual local calculations, ledgers and numerical
controllers are exercised; external/provider paths retain controlled fixtures.
Source/function comparisons and five identical numerical vectors are retained
under `runs/hpc_calculation_ownership_20261111_{baseline,combined,retry,audit,records02,consistency02}/`.
Historical descriptors/source inventories remain provenance. Remaining dependency
review, planning/allocation task splits, full restoration, autonomous scientific
validation and the full-tree goal remain open.

actual_descriptor.qualification: Actual selected operands with the existing descriptor formula; the descriptor may intentionally cover less than transitive dependencies. Saved descriptors are not rewritten or authenticated.

current_original_provider_late_policy_an.description_association: Existing top-level task/objective/parent/children/grading/credit/yield/waiting/persistence/summary and original-to-private descriptions remain substantive. The exact selected private facts and current dependency/provider associations here govern current source identity; dated extraction observations retain their original epoch.
current_original_provider_late_policy_an.installation_evidence_requirement: Current installation status requires an actual application receipt and complete source/metadata membership, byte and mode postchecks recorded in that ledger; preparation is not installation evidence.

current_ownership_authority.priority: Current source/method/dependency identities use this record and refreshed top-level fields; earlier dated source evidence is historical. Unchanged substantive responsibility descriptions remain applicable.
